A stranded dog was rescued from the bed of a pickup truck after rising flash floodwaters trapped the vehicle in Rocksprings, Texas.

Video shows firefighters using a dinghy to reach the truck and safely bring the dog back to dry land. https://t.co/c8JJN3yJ5U

Country star Zach Bryan sparks fresh debate after wearing a "Free Palestine" shirt during his show at Gillette Stadium.

Bryan wore the shirt just weeks after Macklemore said he was dropped from Ed Sheeran's tour after pressure from Gillette Stadium owner Robert Kraft.
